summary: The Joint Corp. files Form 8-K to report closing of an asset sale of 45 company-owned clinics in Southern California to Elite Chiro Group for ~$2.3M. On April 27, 2026, 13 clinics closed with full ownership transfer; the remaining 32 clinics are operated under a Management Service Agreement pending lease assignments. The transaction, along with prior refranchising deals, will reduce corporate-run clinics to 3 out of 960 locations, effectively making The Joint a pure-play franchisor. No board recommendation or advisors named. Watch for pace of remaining lease assignments and risk of delays affecting final close.
